orgDesign.companyProfile: Enable U describes itself as a Dutch data and integration specialist founded in 2005, with more than 180 specialists and more than 400 customers. Vortex Capital Partners records a 2020 buyout and a strategy to grow Enable U's internally developed integration platform through organic growth and acquisitions; the investor profile cites more than 300 Dutch municipalities and more than 5,000 secure integrations. Enable U's history lists JNET (2021), Scamander (2024) and Estreme (2025) as additions. The product landscape spans Managed Integrations, OpenTunnel and Digikoppeling, Microsoft Azure Integration Services, Boomi, Broadcom Layer7 API management, identification, GGM data management, data distribution, Peppol invoicing and e-VOI.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Modeled product-and-service topology for the roughly 120 people closest to product engineering, implementation, managed operations and customer enablement; the remaining capacity in a 180+ person company would cover sales, marketing, finance, people, legal, leadership and other specialists not modeled here. Four groups and twelve teams own bricks end to end. Complicated-subsystem teams isolate government protocols, API trust, Boomi and authoritative registers. Platform teams provide the catalog, shared runtime patterns, release control and evidence. Stream-aligned teams deliver Azure, transactions, data products and reliability outcomes. Consultancy is enabling: it structures assessments and adoption but does not override accountable customer decisions. Automation and AI may suggest mappings, tests, anomaly cohorts or roadmap evidence, but humans approve data semantics, security policy, irreversible recovery, legal transactions and investment choices.
